title: 螺蛳牌楼 Luosi Pailou
subtitle: Hsien Fa Shan Tung Men, East Gate to Hsien Fa Hill · Xiyang Lou

model.line: Simple massing of a European palace: position and footprint from the ruin, the plan or a survey, heights read from the plates of the 1780s (research/xiyanglou/boxes.csv). Not a detailed model yet; the figures and their methods are in the Dimensions block.
rows: east gate, three arches and two side rooms
platform 0.2 m, eave 6.8 m, ridge 11 m above the ground
gable 硬山 or 悬山, glazed tile

evidence.title: Plates XVI to XIX: 观水法, 线法山门, 线法山, 螺蛳牌楼
evidence.excerpt_other: Montagne factice sur laquelle il y a un Ting-tsé,
evidence.summary: XVI throne facing the jets. XVII triumphal arch, the most Greek. XVIII an artificial hill with a 亭 on top. XIX another triumphal arch, less sober.

evidence.title: Engraving 19: 线法山东门 / 螺蛳牌楼
evidence.excerpt_other: was a peculiar gateway of three arches with both side passages leading through side rooms, and with decorations of vine-like trees carved even over the faces of the pillars on the outside of the building.
evidence.summary: Three-arched gate, side passages through side rooms, carved vine ornament on the pillars.

evidence.title: 万花阵 and 花园门; 线法山 and 螺蛳牌楼, yaffin 系列02, 13
evidence.summary: Lead: the maze gate 花园门 is shaped like a Western clock case with two brass doors; the maze 89 x 59 m, walls about 1.2 m high and over 1,600 m long; the hill 线法山 has a gate each side, the east one called 螺蛳牌楼. Check against the engravings.

evidence.title: 线法墙地样 (线法墙平面图)
evidence.locator: 国家图书馆善本部; no shelf number shown; title recorded in 1933 北平图书馆 bulletin per E0993
evidence.summary: Lei plan of the walled plot holding 线法墙, 方河 and 螺蛳牌楼: per the page, 81 zhang E-W (259 m), 19 zhang N-S, with 11 walls from west to east in two lines. Same as E0993, now with figures in a search extract.

photos.title: 线法山东门 (圆明园铜版画册 / 西洋楼铜版画, plate 十九 of 二十; title and number printed on the plate)
photos.creator: 伊兰泰 Yi Lantai (drawings); engraved by court workshops
photos.archive: 故宫博物院 Palace Museum, Beijing
photos.why: CORRECTION: printed title 线法山东门; S06 equates it with 螺蛳牌楼 (山东为线法山东门 所谓螺丝牌楼), and the triple arch fits S02 p.159. So XY13 is sure, not likely. XY12 as the gate it belongs to. Hill not in the frame. Water and hills through the arch are the east, drawn.
photos.attribution: Yi Lantai, 1786, 故宫博物院 Palace Museum, Beijing, via Wikimedia Commons
photos.visible: whole west face: arch, two square-headed doors, two towers, trophies; title 线法山东门

photos.title: 圓明園東長春園平面圖 (第一圖), plan of the Xiyang Lou strip
photos.date: drawn by Ohlmer, 1867-1879, per Teng Gu's preface; from Börschmann's collection
photos.creator: Ernst Ohlmer 奥尔末 (per Teng Gu)
photos.why: Teng Gu: the plan is by Ohlmer too; form agrees with the strip: maze in its court, 谐奇趣 and curved wings, 海晏堂, 方河 and stepped screens.
photos.attribution: Plan by Ernst Ohlmer, from 滕固 Teng Gu 1933, via Wikimedia Commons (CADAL, Sichuan University)
photos.licence: Commons file tag PD-old, shown as "Public domain", on the whole book scan (滕固, 1933; CADAL 11102995, Sichuan University)
photos.visible: whole strip from 谐奇趣 and 黄花阵 in the west to 方河 and 线法墙 in the east; thin dashed lines fan from points, which may be sight lines (not verified)

twins.name: 欧洲凯旋门 European triumphal arch (type)
twins.relation: Comparable: same court, era or type
twins.basis: S02 p.159 calls 线法山门 a triple gateway resembling a European triumphal arch, and 螺蛳牌楼 XY13 a gate of three arches. S415 fig.20 shows the Arc de Triomphe grove at Versailles.

facts.label: Destroyed
facts.value: Looted and burnt 1860; stone ruins stayed, further damage 1900 and after (S02 pp.142,218)

facts.label: Note
facts.value: Copper engraving no. 19 per S02. 3 arches with vine carving (S02 p.159). Round 6 replaced frontage 8.0 m. Round 6 replaced depth 1.5 m.
